summary: Master Email Records Management and ISO 15489 standards. Learn to implement retention, metadata, and automated capture. Enroll to mitigate legal risks.
lede: Email records management gives records, information governance, IT compliance, and legal operations professionals a structured way to manage business correspondence. The course covers classifying and capturing messages, applying metadata, setting retention schedules, and managing legal holds and disposition records. It also addresses email-to-records-system integration and governance of correspondence across email, chat, and other communication channels.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for the integrity, security, and accessibility of organizational communications.
modules: The Capstone Approach and Automated Capture
E-Discovery, Legal Holds, and Search Optimization
Security, Privacy, and GDPR in Correspondence
prerequisites: This is an intermediate-level course. You should have at least two years of experience in records management, IT administration, or legal compliance. Familiarity with basic information governance concepts and standard office productivity suites is required. No prior programming knowledge is necessary, though an understanding of organizational file structures is beneficial.
